sn22.16:1.4: What is nonself should be seen as it really is with correct wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’
sn22.16:1.10: What is nonself should be seen as it really is with correct wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’
sn22.16:1.12: He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’”
